en.s: The Battle of Candespina was fought on 26 October 1110 or 1111 between the forces of Alfonso I of Aragon and those of his estranged wife, Urraca of León and Castile, in the Campo de la Espina near Sepúlveda. Alfonso was victorious, as he would be again in a few weeks at the Battle of Viadangos. The battle was the result of a power struggle between Alfonso and Urraca.

zh.s: 坎德斯皮纳战役于1110年或1111年10月26日爆发，交战双方是阿拉贡国王阿方索一世与其分居的妻子莱昂和卡斯蒂利亚女王乌拉卡的军队，战场位于塞普尔韦达附近的埃斯皮纳平原。阿方索获胜，几周后他又在比亚当戈斯战役中获胜。这场战役源于阿方索与乌拉卡争夺权力。

en.s: The Uprising of Asen and Peter (Bulgarian: Въстание на Асен и Петър) was a revolt of Bulgarians and Vlachs living in Moesia and the Balkan Mountains, then the theme of Paristrion of the Byzantine Empire, caused by a tax increase. It began on 26 October 1185, the feast day of St. Demetrius of Thessaloniki, and ended with the restoration of Bulgaria and the creation of the Second Bulgarian Empire, ruled by the Asen dynasty.

zh.s: 阿森与彼得起义（保加利亚语：Въстание на Асен и Петър）是梅西亚和巴尔干山脉地区的保加利亚人和弗拉赫人发起的一场叛乱。当时这些地区属于拜占庭帝国的帕里斯特里昂军区，起义由加税引发。起义于1185年10月26日圣德米特里日开始，最终恢复保加利亚国家，并建立由阿森王朝统治的第二保加利亚帝国。

en.s: The siege of Bristol lasted from the 18th to 26 October 1326, and saw the city besieged by the forces of Isabella of France and Roger Mortimer during the 1326 Invasion of England. Isabella and Mortimer's forces fought the garrison under Hugh Despenser the Elder for eight days in a siege. They captured the fort after several attacks.

en.s: King Edward III of England led a campaign in the Duchy of Brittany in 1342 and 1343. England, at war with France since 1337 in the Hundred Years' War, had sided with John of Montfort's faction in the War of the Breton Succession soon after it broke out in 1341. The French king, Philip VI, supported the rival claimant, Charles of Blois, who was his nephew.

zh.s: 英格兰国王爱德华三世于1342至1343年在布列塔尼公国发动军事行动。英法自1337年起因百年战争交战，布列塔尼王位继承战争于1341年爆发后不久，英格兰便支持约翰·德·蒙福特一派。法国国王腓力六世则支持另一位继承人、其侄子布卢瓦的夏尔。

en.s: The Battle of the Cosmin Forest was a military engagement between the Kingdom of Poland and a coalition army led by Stephen the Great consisting of mainly Moldavian forces alongside Transylvanian, Wallachian, Ottoman, and Crimean deployments. The battle resulted in a major victory for the coalition army.

zh.s: 科斯明森林之战是波兰王国与斯特凡大公率领的联军之间的一场军事冲突。联军以摩尔达维亚军队为主，另有特兰西瓦尼亚、瓦拉几亚、奥斯曼和克里米亚部队参战。联军取得重大胜利。

en.t: Charles V was crowned as Holy Roman Emperor
en.s: Charles V (24 February 1500 – 21 September 1558) was Holy Roman Emperor and Archduke of Austria from 1519 to 1556, King of Spain (as Charles I) from 1516 to 1556, King of Sicily and Naples from 1516 to 1554, and also Lord of the Netherlands and titular Duke of Burgundy (as Charles II) from 1506 to 1555. He was heir to and then head of the rising House of Habsburg.

zh.t: 查理五世加冕为神圣罗马皇帝
zh.s: 查理五世（1500年2月24日—1558年9月21日）于1519年至1556年担任神圣罗马皇帝和奥地利大公，1516年至1556年担任西班牙国王（称查理一世），1516年至1554年担任西西里和那不勒斯国王，并于1506年至1555年担任尼德兰领主和名义上的勃艮第公爵（称查理二世）。他先是哈布斯堡王朝的继承人，之后成为该王朝首领。

en.s: The siege of Rouen was a key military engagement of the first French War of Religion. After having been seized by those opposing the crown on 16 April, the siege, beginning on 28 May and culminating on 26 October brought the important city of Rouen back into the crown's control. The fall of Rouen would set the stage for the main battle of the war at Dreux several months later.

zh.s: 鲁昂围城战是第一次法国宗教战争中的一场重要战役。鲁昂于4月16日被王室反对者占领后，王室军队于5月28日开始围城，并于10月26日夺回这座重要城市。数月后，这场战役为战争中的主战——德勒战役——铺平了道路。

en.s: The Battle of Slunj (Croatian: Bitka kod Slunja) was fought on 26 October 1584 between the Ottoman forces of the Bosnian Beglerbeg, Ferhad Pasha Sokolović, and Germanic and Croatian forces led by Jobst Joseph von Thurn and Thomas Erdődy, the Ban of Croatia. The battle was a part of the Croatian–Ottoman wars and Ottoman–Habsburg wars between the Ottoman Empire and the Habsburg Monarchy. Ottoman troops were estimated at between 8-10,000 men, and the army of Thurn and Erdödy consisted of 1,300 infantry and 700 cavalry. The battle resulted in a crushing defeat for the Ottoman forces.

zh.s: 斯卢尼战役（克罗地亚语：Bitka kod Slunja）于1584年10月26日爆发，交战双方是波斯尼亚贝勒贝伊费尔哈德·帕夏·索科洛维奇率领的奥斯曼军队，以及约布斯特·约瑟夫·冯·图恩和克罗地亚总督托马斯·埃尔德迪率领的德意志和克罗地亚军队。战役属于克罗地亚—奥斯曼战争及奥斯曼—哈布斯堡战争的一部分。奥斯曼军队估计有8,000至10,000人，图恩和埃尔德迪的军队有1,300名步兵和700名骑兵。奥斯曼军队惨败。

en.s: The Battle of Vimory occurred on 26 October 1587 between the French royal (Catholic) forces of King Henry III of France commanded by Henry of Guise and German and Swiss mercenaires commanded by Fabien I, Burgrave of Dohna and William-Robert de la Marck, Duke of Bouillon who were hired to assist Henry of Navarre's Huguenot forces during the eighth and final war (1585-1598) of the French Wars of Religion. The Protestant mercenaries were funded by Elizabeth I of England and the King of Denmark. After having pillaged the Lorraine region, they arrived in Burgundy and entered into the Beauce region.

zh.s: 维莫里战役于1587年10月26日爆发。法王亨利三世的天主教王军由吉斯公爵亨利指挥，与为纳瓦拉的亨利的胡格诺派军队提供援助的德意志和瑞士雇佣兵交战。雇佣兵由多纳伯爵约布斯特一世·法比安和布永公爵威廉-罗伯特·德·拉马克率领，费用由英格兰女王伊丽莎白一世和丹麦国王承担。雇佣兵洗劫洛林地区后抵达勃艮第，并进入博斯地区。这场战役发生在法国宗教战争最后一场战争（1585—1598年）期间。

en.s: The Battle of Keresztes (also known as the Battle of Mezőkeresztes) (Turkish: Haçova Muharebesi) took place on 24–26 October 1596. It was fought between a combined Habsburg-Transylvanian force and the Ottoman Empire near the village of Mezőkeresztes (Turkish: Haçova) in modern-day northern Hungary. The Ottomans routed the Habsburg-led army, but due to their own losses, they were unable to exploit their victory.

zh.s: 凯雷斯特斯战役又称梅泽凯雷斯特斯战役（土耳其语：Haçova Muharebesi），于1596年10月24日至26日进行。战役发生在今匈牙利北部梅泽凯雷斯特斯村附近，交战双方为哈布斯堡—特兰西瓦尼亚联军和奥斯曼帝国。奥斯曼军队击溃了哈布斯堡联军，但自身损失也很大，无法扩大战果。

en.s: The Battle of Myeongnyang was fought on October 26, 1597 between the Joseon Navy led by Admiral Yi Sun-sin and the Japanese navy in the Myeongnyang Strait, near Jindo Island, off the southwest corner of the Korean Peninsula. With only 13 ships remaining from Admiral Wŏn Kyun's disastrous defeat at the Battle of Chilcheollyang, Admiral Yi held the strait as a "last stand" battle against the Japanese navy, who were sailing to support their land army's advance towards the Joseon capital of Hanyang (modern-day Seoul).

zh.s: 鸣梁海战于1597年10月26日爆发，交战双方是李舜臣将军率领的朝鲜海军和日本海军，战场位于朝鲜半岛西南角外的珍岛附近鸣梁海峡。李舜臣的舰队此前在漆川梁海战中惨败，只剩13艘船。面对驶来支援日军陆军向朝鲜首都汉阳（今首尔）推进的日本海军，李舜臣据守海峡，作最后一搏。

en.s: The Treaty of Ripon was a truce between Charles I, King of England, and the Covenanters, a Scottish political movement, which brought a cessation of hostilities to the Second Bishops' War. The Covenanter movement had arisen in opposition to attempts by Charles, who was also King of Scotland, to reform the Church of Scotland to bring it into closer alignment with the Church of England.
en.n: The Treaty of Ripon is signed, restoring peace between Covenanter Scotland and King Charles I of England.

zh.s: 《里彭条约》是英王查理一世与苏格兰盟约派运动之间的停战协议，结束了第二次主教战争的敌对行动。盟约派反对查理一世试图改革苏格兰教会、使其更接近英格兰教会的做法；查理一世当时同时也是苏格兰国王。
zh.n: 《里彭条约》签署，苏格兰盟约派与英王查理一世恢复和平。

en.s: The War of the Reunions (1683–84) was a conflict between France, Spain and the Holy Roman Empire, with limited involvement by Genoa. It can be seen as a continuation of the War of Devolution (1667–1668) and the Franco-Dutch War (1672–1678), which were driven by Louis XIV's determination to establish defensible boundaries along France's northern and eastern borders.

zh.s: 重聚战争（1683—1684年）是法国、西班牙和神圣罗马帝国之间的冲突，热那亚也有限度地参与其中。它可被视为遗产战争（1667—1668年）和法荷战争（1672—1678年）的延续；这两场战争源自路易十四希望在法国北部和东部边境建立易于防守的界线。

en.s: The fire of Skopje started on 26 October 1689 and lasted for two days, burning much of the city; only some stone-built structures, such as the fortress and some churches and mosques, were relatively undamaged. The fire had a disastrous effect on the city: its population declined from around 60,000 to around 10,000, and it lost its regional importance as a trading centre.

zh.s: 斯科普里大火于1689年10月26日开始，持续两天，烧毁了城市大部分地区。只有要塞以及一些教堂、清真寺等石砌建筑基本未受损。大火对城市造成灾难性影响：人口从约60,000人降至约10,000人，斯科普里也失去区域贸易中心的地位。

en.s: The First Continental Congress was a meeting of delegates of twelve of the Thirteen Colonies (Georgia did not attend) held from September 5 to October 26, 1774, at Carpenters' Hall in Philadelphia at the beginning of the American Revolution. The meeting was organized by the delegates just after the British Navy implemented a blockade of Boston Harbor and the Parliament of Great Britain passed the punitive Intolerable Acts in response to the Boston Tea Party.
en.n: American Revolution: The First Continental Congress adjourns in Philadelphia.

zh.s: 第一届大陆会议是美国独立战争初期举行的一次代表会议，来自十三个殖民地中的十二个（佐治亚未参加）的代表于1774年9月5日至10月26日在费城木匠厅与会。会议由代表们组织召开，当时英国海军刚对波士顿港实施封锁，英国议会也刚针对波士顿倾茶事件通过惩罚性《不可容忍法案》。

en.s: The siege of Kehl lasted from 26 October 1796 to 9 January 1797. Habsburg and Württemberg regulars numbering 40,000, under the command of Maximilian Anton Karl, Count Baillet de Latour, besieged and captured the French-controlled fortifications at the village of Kehl in the German state of Baden-Durlach. The fortifications at Kehl represented an important bridgehead crossing the Rhine to Strasbourg, an Alsatian city and a French Revolutionary stronghold.

zh.s: 凯尔围城战持续时间为1796年10月26日至1797年1月9日。马克西米利安·安东·卡尔·巴耶·德·拉图尔伯爵率领40,000名哈布斯堡和符腾堡正规军，围攻并攻占了位于德国巴登-杜拉赫地区凯尔村、由法国控制的防御工事。凯尔工事是跨越莱茵河的重要桥头堡，对面的斯特拉斯堡是阿尔萨斯的一座城市，也是法国大革命的重要据点。

en.s: The Battle of Escamela took place during the War of Mexican Independence on 26 October 1812 in the area around Escamela, Ixtaczoquitlán, Veracruz. The battle was fought between the royalist forces loyal to the Spanish crown, and the Mexican rebels fighting for independence from the Spanish Empire. The battle resulted in a victory for the Mexican rebels.

zh.s: 埃斯卡梅拉战役于1812年10月26日在墨西哥独立战争期间爆发，地点在韦拉克鲁斯州伊斯塔克索基特兰的埃斯卡梅拉一带。交战双方是效忠西班牙王室的保王派军队和争取脱离西班牙帝国独立的墨西哥起义军。墨西哥起义军获胜。

en.s: The Battle of the Chateauguay was an engagement of the War of 1812. On 26 October 1813, a British force consisting of 1,630 regulars, volunteers and militia from Lower Canada and Mohawk warriors, commanded by Charles de Salaberry, repelled an American force of about 4,000, including 2,600 regulars, attempting to invade Lower Canada and ultimately attack Montreal. The Battle of the Chateauguay was one of the two battles (the other being the Battle of Crysler's Farm) which caused the Americans to abandon the Saint Lawrence Campaign, their major strategic effort in the autumn of 1813.

zh.s: 夏多盖战役是1812年战争期间的一场战斗。1813年10月26日，查尔斯·德·萨拉贝里指挥一支1,630人的英军，包括下加拿大正规军、志愿兵、民兵和莫霍克战士，击退了约4,000人的美国军队，其中包括2,600名正规军。美国军队原计划入侵下加拿大，最终进攻蒙特利尔。夏多盖战役与克莱斯勒农场战役一同迫使美国放弃1813年秋季的圣劳伦斯战役行动，这是美军当时最重要的战略行动。

en.t: The Erie Canal opens, allowing direct passage from the Hudson River to Lake Erie
en.s: The Erie Canal is a historic canal in upstate New York that runs east–west between the Hudson River and Lake Erie. Completed in 1825, the canal was the first navigable waterway connecting the Atlantic Ocean to the upper Great Lakes above Niagara Falls, vastly reducing the costs of transporting people and goods across the Appalachians.

zh.t: 伊利运河通航，连接哈德逊河与伊利湖
zh.s: 伊利运河是纽约州北部一条东西向的历史运河，连接哈德逊河和伊利湖。运河于1825年竣工，是首条连接大西洋与尼亚加拉瀑布以西五大湖上游水域的可通航水道，大幅降低了人们和货物翻越阿巴拉契亚山脉的运输成本。

en.s: The Expedition of the Thousand (Italian: Spedizione dei Mille) was an event of the unification of Italy that took place in 1860. A corps of volunteers led by Giuseppe Garibaldi sailed from Quarto al Mare near Genoa and landed in Marsala, Sicily, in order to conquer the Kingdom of the Two Sicilies, ruled by the Spanish House of Bourbon-Two Sicilies.

en.s: The Declaration of Neutrality (German: Neutralitätserklärung) was a declaration by the Austrian Parliament declaring the country permanently neutral. It was enacted on 26 October 1955 as a constitutional act of parliament, i.e., as part of the Constitution of Austria. Pursuant to resolution of the Federal Assembly of Parliament following the Austrian State Treaty, Austria declared "its permanent neutrality of its own accord".

zh.s: 《中立宣言》（德语：Neutralitätserklärung）是奥地利议会宣布该国永久保持中立的一项宣言。议会于1955年10月26日通过这项宪法法案，将其纳入奥地利宪法。奥地利国家条约签订后，议会联邦大会通过决议，奥地利据此宣布“自愿永久中立”。

en.s: Ngô Đình Diệm ( dyem, YEE-əm or zeem; Vietnamese: [ŋō ɗìn jîəmˀ] ; 3 January 1901 – 2 November 1963) was a South Vietnamese politician. He was the final prime minister of the State of Vietnam (1954–1955), and later the first president of South Vietnam (Republic of Vietnam) from 1955 until his capture and assassination during the CIA-backed 1963 coup d'état.

en.s: A referendum was held in the State of Vietnam (South Vietnam) to determine whether the country was a republic or monarchy. en.s: The election for the seventh Senate of South Africa took place on October 26, 1960, with the appointment of nominated Senators by the Governor-General taking place on November 16, 1960. The Senate Act 1960 reduced the size of the Senate and reinstated proportional representation elections, as it had been up until the election of 1955.

en.s: The coronation of Mohammad Reza Pahlavi and Farah Pahlavi, the shah and shahbanu of Iran, took place on 26 October 1967, the Shah's 48th birthday, in the Salam Hall of the Golestan Palace. Mohammad Reza Pahlavi placed the Pahlavi Crown on himself and crowned his wife Farah, who became the first and only woman to be crowned as the empress consort of Iran.

en.s: Soyuz 3 (Russian: Союз 3, Union 3) was a spaceflight mission launched by the Soviet Union on 26 October 1968. Flown by Georgy Beregovoy, the Soyuz 7K-OK spacecraft completed 81 orbits over four days. The 47-year-old Beregovoy was a decorated World War II flying ace and the oldest person to go into orbit up to that time.

zh.s: 联盟3号（俄语：Союз 3，意为“联盟3号”）是苏联于1968年10月26日发射的一次载人航天任务。格奥尔基·别列戈沃伊驾驶联盟7K-OK飞船，在4天内绕地球飞行81圈。47岁的别列戈沃伊曾是功勋卓著的二战王牌飞行员，也是当时进入地球轨道的最年长者。

en.s: Parliamentary elections were held in Portugal on 26 October 1969. The elections were announced on 12 August, and were the first under Prime Minister Marcelo Caetano, appointed in the previous year to replace long-term Prime Minister Antonio de Oliveira Salazar, who had been left incapacitated after a stroke. The quasi-sovereign National Union won all seats with an official turnout of 62.5%.

en.s: The 1970 New Brunswick general election was held on October 26, 1970, to elect 58 members to the 47th New Brunswick Legislative Assembly, the governing house of the province of New Brunswick, Canada. It saw the Liberals defeated, and a new Conservative government take over in the Canadian Province of New Brunswick. Louis Robichaud, the Liberal premier since 1960, called the election early by surprise.

zh.s: 加拿大新不伦瑞克省于1970年10月26日举行大选，选出第47届省立法议会的58名议员。自由党落败，新保守党政府上台。自1960年起担任自由党省长的路易·罗比肖出人意料地提前宣布举行选举。

en.s: The Rochdale by-election, 1972, was a parliamentary by-election held on 26 October 1972 for the British House of Commons constituency of Rochdale. The by-election took place during the 1970s Liberal revival, in one of the areas with few Labour held seats and where the Liberal Party was in second place. This was the first Liberal gain during the 1970–1974 Parliament.

en.s: The 1972 Dahomeyan coup d'état was a military coup staged on 26 October 1972 by Major (later General) Mathieu Kérékou, who took control of the Republic of Dahomey and ended a system of government established following the annulled 1970 presidential election, in which three members of the Presidential Council (Hubert Maga, Justin Ahomadégbé-Tomêtin and Sourou-Migan Apithy) were to rotate in power.

zh.s: 达荷美共和国于1972年10月26日发生军事政变，由马蒂厄·克雷库少校（后为将军）发动并掌权，终结了1970年总统选举作废后建立的轮替执政制度。按该制度，总统委员会三名成员休伯特·马加、贾斯汀·阿霍马德贝-托梅廷和苏鲁-米甘·阿皮西将轮流执政。

en.s: General elections were held in Botswana on 26 October 1974. With 205,050 registered voters, turnout was just 31.22%. The result was a third successive landslide victory for the Botswana Democratic Party (BDP), who won 27 of the 32 elected seats, including four in which they were unopposed. Local elections were held on the same day, with a turnout of just 30.3%, and saw the BDP strengthen its position.

zh.s: 博茨瓦纳于1974年10月26日举行大选。205,050名登记选民中，投票率仅为31.22%。博茨瓦纳民主党连续第三次大获全胜，赢得32个民选席位中的27席，其中4席没有对手。地方选举也在同日举行，投票率仅为30.3%，博茨瓦纳民主党的地位进一步巩固。

en.s: The 1974 Scottish League Cup final was played on 26 October 1974 and was the final of the 29th Scottish League Cup competition. It was contested by Hibernian and Celtic. Celtic won the match 6–3, with John "Dixie" Deans and Joe Harper scoring hat-tricks for each side. Jimmy Johnstone, Steve Murray and Paul Wilson scored Celtic's other goals.

en.s: General elections were held in Tanzania on 26 October 1975. The country was a one-party state at the time, with the Tanganyika African National Union as the sole legal party on the mainland, and the Afro-Shirazi Party was the only party in Zanzibar. For the National Assembly election there were two candidates from the same party in each of the constituencies (although 40 were elected unopposed), whilst the presidential election was effectively a referendum on TANU leader Julius Nyerere's candidacy. Voter turnout was 81.7% for both elections. The country's population was around 15 million at the time of the election.

zh.s: 坦桑尼亚于1975年10月26日举行大选。当时该国实行一党制：坦噶尼喀非洲民族联盟是大陆唯一合法政党，桑给巴尔则由非洲—设拉子党独自合法参选。国民议会选举中，每个选区有两名同一政党的候选人，但有40人因没有对手直接当选。总统选举实际上是对坦噶尼喀非洲民族联盟领导人朱利叶斯·尼雷尔参选的全民公投。两项选举的投票率均为81.7%。选举时该国人口约1,500万。

en.s: Parliamentary elections were held in Mauritania on 26 October 1975. The country was a one-party state with the Mauritanian People's Party (PPM) as the sole legal party. It therefore won all 70 seats in the National Assembly. Voter turnout was 87.4%.

zh.s: 毛里塔尼亚于1975年10月26日举行议会选举。当时该国实行一党制，毛里塔尼亚人民党（PPM）是唯一合法政党，因此赢得国民议会全部70个席位。投票率为87.4%。

en.s: On 26 October 1979, Park Chung Hee, the third president of South Korea, was assassinated during a dinner at the Korean Central Intelligence Agency (KCIA) safe house near the Blue House presidential compound in Jongno District, Seoul, South Korea. It was the first assassination of a head of state on the Korean peninsula in 605 years since the assassination of King Gongmin of Goryeo.

zh.s: 1979年10月26日，韩国第三任总统朴正熙在首尔钟路区青瓦台总统府附近的韩国中央情报部安全屋内用餐时遇刺身亡。这是朝鲜半岛605年来首次有国家元首遭刺杀；此前一次是高丽恭愍王遇刺。

en.s: The Israel–Jordan peace treaty (formally the Treaty of Peace Between the State of Israel and the Hashemite Kingdom of Jordan), sometimes referred to as the Wadi Araba Treaty, is an agreement that ended the state of war that had existed between the two countries since the 1948 Arab–Israeli War and established mutual diplomatic relations. In addition to establishing peace between the two countries, the treaty also settled land and water disputes, provided for broad cooperation in tourism and trade, and obligated both countries to prevent their territory being used as a staging ground for military strikes by a third country. The signing ceremony took place at the southern border crossing of Arabah on 26 October 1994.

zh.s: 《以色列国与约旦哈希姆王国和平条约》又称《以色列—约旦和平条约》，有时也称《阿拉巴河谷条约》。条约结束了两国自1948年阿以战争以来的战争状态，并建立相互外交关系。除实现和平外，条约还解决了土地和水资源争端，推动旅游和贸易等领域广泛合作，并规定两国都必须阻止第三国利用本国领土作为发动军事袭击的基地。签字仪式于1994年10月26日在阿拉巴南部边境口岸举行。

en.s: W.A.K.O. World Championships 2003 in Paris were the joint fourteenth world championships held by the W.A.K.O. and the first ever to be held in France. The other (joint) world championships were to be held in November of the same year in Yalta, Ukraine. The event was open to amateur men and women with approximately 780 athletes from 63 countries across the world taking part. There were four styles on offer at Paris; Full-Contact, Light-Contact, Semi-Contact and Aero-Kickboxing. The other W.A.K.O. styles (Low-Kick, Thai-Boxing and Musical Forms) would be held at the second event later in the year at Yalta. en.s: The 2008 Nord-Kivu campaign was an armed conflict in the eastern Nord-Kivu province of the Democratic Republic of the Congo. The upsurge of violence in the Kivu conflict saw heavy battles between the Democratic Republic of Congo's army, supported by the United Nations, and Tutsi militia under General Laurent Nkunda. The fighting, which began on October 25, uprooted 250,000 civilians — bringing the total of people displaced by the Kivu conflict to more than 2 million.

en.s: An indirect presidential election was held in the Marshall Islands on 26 October 2009 following the ousting of incumbent President Litokwa Tomeing in the nation's first successful vote of no confidence on 21 October 2009. Tomeing had been temporarily replaced by Ruben Zackhras as acting president. Only two candidates were nominated for President, who is elected by the 33-member Nitijela. The candidates were Speaker Jurelang Zedkaia and former President Kessai Note, who had led the no confidence measure against Tomeing. Tomeing and Kessai had engaged in a power struggle since Kessai had lost his re-election bid in the 2007 election.

en.s: Legislative elections were held in Tunisia on 26 October 2014. Campaigning started on 4 October 2014. They were the first free regular legislative elections since independence in 1956, and the first elections held following the adoption of the new constitution in January 2014, which created a 217-seat Assembly of the Representatives of the People. According to preliminary results, Nidaa Tounes gained a plurality of votes, winning 85 seats in the 217-seat parliament, beating the Ennahda Movement (69 seats) and many smaller parties. Presidential elections were held a month later on 23 November.

en.s: General elections were held in Uruguay on 26 October 2014, alongside a constitutional referendum. Since no presidential candidate received an absolute majority, a runoff took place on 30 November 2014. Primary elections had been held on 1 June 2014. Incumbent President José Mujica was ineligible to run owing to a constitutional limit on serving consecutive terms. The governing Broad Front nominated former President Tabaré Vázquez as its candidate, with Vázquez defeating Luis Alberto Lacalle Pou of the National Party in the second round of voting by the widest margin since the run-off system was first implemented in 1999.

zh.s: 乌拉圭于2014年10月26日举行大选，并举行宪法公投。由于没有总统候选人获得绝对多数，决选于2014年11月30日举行。初选此前已于2014年6月1日举行。受宪法连续任期限制，现任总统何塞·穆希卡不能参选。执政的广泛阵线提名前总统塔瓦雷·巴斯克斯参选，巴斯克斯在第二轮中击败民族党候选人路易斯·阿尔贝托·拉卡列·波，优势之大为1999年首次实施决选制度以来之最。

en.s: A snap parliamentary election for the Verkhovna Rada took place in Ukraine on 26 October 2014. The President of Ukraine, Petro Poroshenko, announced the date of the election on 25 August 2014. Poroshenko had pressed for early parliamentary elections since his victory in the May 2014 presidential election. Because of the ongoing War in Donbass and the unilateral annexation of Crimea by Russia, the elections were not held in all of the regions of Ukraine. On 2 September 2014 the Central Election Commission of Ukraine announced that voting would not be held for the 12 Verkhovna Rada constituencies in Crimea and Sevastopol.

en.s: The 2020 Saskatchewan general election was held on October 26, 2020 to elect members of the Legislative Assembly of Saskatchewan. This date was set by Saskatchewan's fixed election date law. The writ was dropped on September 29 just in time to hold the election on October 26. The previous election re-elected the Saskatchewan Party to its third consecutive majority government under the leadership of Brad Wall.

zh.s: 萨斯喀彻温省于2020年10月26日举行大选，选出省立法议会议员。选举日期依照该省固定选举日期法确定。选举令于9月29日发布，以便按期在10月26日投票。上次大选中，布拉德·沃尔领导的萨斯喀彻温党连续第三次赢得多数政府并连任执政。

en.t: 2020 Ladakh Autonomous Hill Development Council, Leh election
en.s: Elections were held in October 2020 for the 26 seats of Ladakh Autonomous Hill Development Council, Leh. The Bharatiya Janata Party won 15 and formed the government with a majority while the Indian National Congress won 9 seats respectively out of the 26 seats. The other 2 seats were won by 2 independent candidates. Tashi Gyalson of the Bharatiya Janata Party was elected the Chief Executive Councillor.

zh.t: 2020年拉达克列城自治山地发展委员会选举
zh.s: 2020年10月举行选举，选出拉达克列城自治山地发展委员会26个席位。印度人民党赢得15席并以多数优势组阁，印度国民大会党赢得9席，另外2席由2名无党籍候选人获得。印度人民党候选人塔希·嘉尔森当选行政委员会主席。

en.s: The 2021 NXT Halloween Havoc was the second annual Halloween Havoc professional wrestling event produced by WWE, and 14th Halloween Havoc event overall. It was held exclusively for wrestlers from the promotion's NXT brand division. The event aired as a special episode of WWE's weekly television series NXT, broadcast on the USA Network. It took place on October 26, 2021, at the WWE Performance Center in Orlando, Florida.

zh.s: 2021年NXT《万圣节浩劫》是WWE制作的第二届年度《万圣节浩劫》职业摔角赛事，也是该系列第14场赛事。赛事仅由WWE旗下NXT品牌选手参加，并作为WWE每周电视节目《NXT》的特别节目在USA电视网播出。赛事于2021年10月26日在佛罗里达州奥兰多的WWE表演中心举行。

en.s: Municipal elections were held in the Canadian province of Manitoba on October 26, 2022. Mayors, councils and school board trustees were elected in the 135 municipalities holding elections. 64 municipalities, approximately 47.5%, had their mayor or reeve acclaimed due to no other candidates running, with one municipality not putting up any candidates. 860 members were elected, out of 1380 original candidates, with only 55.2% of candidates being reelected overall, only 45.5% of mayoral candidates being reelected.

zh.s: 加拿大马尼托巴省于2022年10月26日举行市政选举。在举行选举的135个市镇中，选民选出市长、市议会成员和学区委员。64个市镇（约47.5%）因无人竞争而直接宣布市长或地方首长当选；另有一个市镇没有候选人。原有的1,380名候选人中有860人当选。整体而言，只有55.2%的候选人连任，市长候选人的连任比例仅为45.5%。

en.s: The 2022 Winnipeg municipal election took place on October 26, 2022. The offices of mayor, city councillors, and school trustees of the city of Winnipeg were elected as a result of this election. Elections were held as part of municipal elections held across the province. The elections used the first-past-the-post voting election system, either to elect the mayor in a municipality-wide district, or to elect councillors in single-member wards.

zh.s: 温尼伯于2022年10月26日举行市政选举，选出市长、市议员和学区委员。选举是全省市政选举的一部分，采用简单多数制：市长在全市范围内选举，市议员则在单议席选区选出。

en.s: Pradeshiya Sabha elections were held in Elpitiya on 26 October 2024 to elect 30 members to the Elpitiya Pradeshiya Sabha. National People's Power (NPP) emerged as the largest party, winning 15 out of 30 seats and securing 47.64% of the vote share. On 8 November 2024, the Election Commission of Sri Lanka confirmed the appointments of NPP's Kolamba Thanthreege Nishantha Perera as chairman and Wagoda Pathirage Sumith Chandana as vice chairman of the Pradeshiya Sabha.

zh.s: 斯里兰卡埃尔皮蒂亚于2024年10月26日举行地方议会选举，选出埃尔皮蒂亚地方议会的30名成员。国家人民力量党（NPP）成为最大党，赢得30席中的15席，得票率为47.64%。斯里兰卡选举委员会于2024年11月8日确认，NPP的科伦巴·坦特里格·尼尚塔·佩雷拉出任议会议长，瓦戈达·帕蒂拉格·苏米特·钱达纳出任副议长。

en.s: The 2024 Bound for Glory was a professional wrestling pay-per-view (PPV) event produced by Total Nonstop Action Wrestling (TNA). It took place on October 26, 2024, at Wayne State Fieldhouse in Detroit, Michigan. It was the 20th event under the Bound for Glory chronology. Wrestlers from WWE's NXT brand and Mexico's Lucha Libre AAA Worldwide (AAA) promotion appeared on the show due to TNA having partnerships with the respective entities.

zh.s: 2024年《荣耀之路》是全面不间断摔角（TNA）制作的一场职业摔角付费直播赛事，于2024年10月26日在密歇根州底特律的韦恩州立大学体育馆举行。这是该系列第20场赛事。由于TNA与WWE的NXT品牌及墨西哥AAA世界摔角推广公司有合作关系，这两家机构的选手也参加了赛事。

en.s: The 2024 Victorian local elections were held on 26 October 2024 to elect the councils of 78 of the 79 local government areas (LGAs) in Victoria. The elections were conducted by the Victorian Electoral Commission (VEC), with voting taking place via post throughout October to elect 647 councillors across the state.

en.s: The 2024 Queensland state election was held on 26 October 2024 to elect all members to the Legislative Assembly of Queensland pursuant to the Constitution (Fixed Term Parliament) Amendment Act 2015. As a result of the 2016 Queensland term length referendum, the term of the parliament will run for four years. The election was the first since 2006 to feature two men leading the major parties.

zh.s: 昆士兰州于2024年10月26日举行州选举，按照《2015年宪法（固定议会任期）修正法》选出州立法议会全部议员。2016年昆士兰州议会任期公投后，议会任期定为4年。这是自2006年以来，主要政党由两位男性领袖带队参选的首次选举。

en.s: The 2024 Melbourne City Council election was held on 26 October 2024 to elect nine councillors and a leadership team (consisting of a lord mayor and deputy lord mayor) to the Council. The election was held as part of the statewide local government elections in Victoria, Australia. Incumbent lord mayor Nicholas Reece was re-elected with 61.5% of the two-candidate-preferred vote.

zh.s: 墨尔本于2024年10月26日举行市议会选举，选出9名市议员以及由市长和副市长组成的领导团队。此次选举是澳大利亚维多利亚州全州地方政府选举的一部分。现任市长尼古拉斯·里斯以两名候选人优先计票得票率61.5%连任。

en.s: Parliamentary elections were held in Georgia on 26 October 2024. The elections were held under the rules adopted in 2017 through the constitutional amendments which shifted the electoral system towards a fully proportional representation with a 5% electoral threshold. The ruling Georgian Dream (GD) party sought to win its fourth term in office.

zh.s: 格鲁吉亚于2024年10月26日举行议会选举。选举依照2017年宪法修正案通过的规则举行，该修正案推动选举制度改为完全比例代表制，并设5%的得票门槛。执政的格鲁吉亚梦想党争取第四个执政任期。

en.s: The Adelaide Film Festival (AFF, formerly ADLFF) is a film festival usually held for two weeks in mid-October in cinemas in Adelaide, South Australia. Originally presented biennially in March from 2003, since 2013 AFF has been held in October. Subject to funding, the festival has staged full or briefer events in alternating years; some form of event has taken place every year since 2015.

zh.s: 阿德莱德电影节（AFF，旧称ADLFF）通常于10月中旬在南澳大利亚州阿德莱德的电影院举行，为期两周。电影节最初自2003年起每两年于3月举办；自2013年起改在10月举行。视资金情况，电影节会隔年举办完整或精简活动；自2015年以来，每年都举办过某种形式的活动。

en.s: The 61st Chicago International Film Festival took place from October 15 to 26, 2025, in Chicago, United States. The festival opened with American documentary film One Golden Summer by Kevin Shaw. Festival events took place mainly around AMC NEWCITY 14, though other event venues throughout the city include the Music Box Theatre, the Gene Siskel Film Center, the Chicago History Museum, and the Reva and David Logan Center for the Arts at the University of Chicago.
